system.description:
FOCUS FLOURISH MOVEMENT TECHNIQUE Action 1 AP

You centre yourself and move with extraordinary speed. As part of this action, you move twice: two Strides, two Steps, or one Stride and one Step in either order. You gain the concealed condition during this movement and until the start of your next turn.

Automated: press Use: 1 AP (a Flourish) and this use. Move your token up to twice your Speed (two Strides; a Step counts as 5 ft); you are Concealed until the start of your next turn.
